name: The Krampus Bell
objective: The stolen object is revealed: the Krampus Bell, an ancient artifact. Ringing it allows the user to communicate with Pokémon beyond the boundaries of the region. Team Krampus intends to use it to awaken something.
intro: The researcher unwraps the villagers' inventory of what was taken. What's missing is not money or Pokémon. It is a bell older than the village itself.
dialogue: Researcher: "According to legend, ringing the bell lets you speak with Pokémon that exist beyond the normal boundaries of the region."
Researcher: "Team Krampus means to use it to awaken something. Follow them."
